## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

  replicate(nSamples, mean(rbinom(nSites,size=1,prob=meanVal)))

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
states <- map_data("state")
counties <- map_data('county')



GCoords<-data.frame(scaffold=c("Chr01","Chr01","Chr01"),window=c(22600000,19300000,46600000))

#read in fixed file
data<-read.delim(file="mue_mac_bic_100000.perl.txt",na.strings = "NA",sep="\t")
samp_meta<-read.delim("/hpc/group/manoslab/QMACROCARPA_GENOMES/26_MAC_PAINTING/SampSpUpdate.txt")

for(i in 1:length(GCoords$scaffold)){
  extractGCoords<-subset(data,scaffold==GCoords$scaffold[i]&pos>GCoords$window[i]-50000&pos<GCoords$window[i]+50000)
  extractGCoords_long<-reshape2::melt(data = extractGCoords,id.vars = c("scaffold","pos","p1","p2"))
  extractGCoords_long<-merge(extractGCoords_long,samp_meta,by.x="variable",by.y="Bam",all.x = TRUE,all.y = FALSE)
  extractGCoords_long<-subset(extractGCoords_long,Species_ept=="macrocarpa")
  write.table(extractGCoords_long,paste(GCoords$scaffold[i],"_",GCoords$window[i],".tsv",sep=""),sep="\t")
  #make long
  pdf(file=paste(GCoords$scaffold[i],"_",GCoords$window[i],"_paint.pdf",sep=""),width=8,height=5)
  


  print(ggplot(extractGCoords_long)+

      geom_tile(mapping=aes(x=pos,y=variable,fill=as.character(value)))+
      labs(fill=NA)+
      theme_light()+
      theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.major = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2","purple4")) 
  )
  print(ggplot(extractGCoords_long)+
      geom_tile(mapping=aes(x=as.character(pos),y=variable,fill=as.character(value)))+
      labs(fill=NA)+
      theme_light()+
      theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.major = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
     scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2","purple4")) 
    )
  dev.off()

  extractGCoords_long_agg<-aggregate(as.numeric(extractGCoords_long$value),by=list(extractGCoords_long$collectionNumber,extractGCoords_long$latitude.orig,extractGCoords_long$longitude.orig,extractGCoords_long$Species_ept,extractGCoords_long$scaffold),function(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE))
  
  pdf(file=paste(GCoords$scaffold[i],"_",GCoords$window[i],"_map.pdf",sep=""),height=5,width=5)
  print(ggplot(data=extractGCoords_long_agg)+
      geom_polygon(data = counties, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),fill = 'white', color = "white", lwd = 0.1)+
      geom_polygon(data=states,aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = NA, color = "gray85")+
      coord_map(xlim = c(-105,-68))+
    #map background
      geom_jitter(mapping=aes(x=Group.3,y=Group.2,color=x),height = .5,width = .5,size=1)+
      scale_color_viridis_c(limits=c(0,1),direction=-1)+
      theme_light())
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
states <- map_data("state")
counties <- map_data('county')
Canada<-map_data("world", "Canada")


GCoords<-read.delim(file="adaptIntCoords.txt",na.strings="NA",sep="\t")

#read in fixed file
data<-read.delim(file="mue_mac_bic.perl.txt",na.strings = "NA",sep="\t")
samp_meta<-read.delim("/hpc/group/manoslab/QMACROCARPA_GENOMES/26_MAC_PAINTING/SampSpUpdate.txt")

for(i in 1:length(GCoords$csome)){
  extractGCoords<-subset(data,scaffold==GCoords$csome[i]&pos>GCoords$start[i]&pos<GCoords$stop[i])
  extractGCoords_long<-reshape2::melt(data = extractGCoords,id.vars = c("scaffold","pos","p1","p2"))
  extractGCoords_long<-merge(extractGCoords_long,samp_meta,by.x="variable",by.y="Bam",all.x = TRUE,all.y = FALSE)
  extractGCoords_long<-subset(extractGCoords_long,Species_ept=="macrocarpa")
  write.table(extractGCoords_long,paste(GCoords$csome[i],"_",GCoords$pos[i],".tsv",sep=""),sep="\t")
  #make long
  pdf(file=paste("mue_",GCoords$csome[i],"_",GCoords$pos[i],"_paint.pdf",sep=""),width=8,height=5)



  print(ggplot(extractGCoords_long)+

      geom_tile(mapping=aes(x=pos,y=variable,fill=as.character(value)))+
      labs(fill=NA)+
      theme_light()+
      theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.major = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
      scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2","purple4"))
  )
  print(ggplot(extractGCoords_long)+
      geom_tile(mapping=aes(x=as.character(pos),y=variable,fill=as.character(value)))+
      labs(fill=NA)+
      theme_light()+
      theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.major = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
     scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2","purple4"))
    )
  dev.off()

```
